_comment: battle —— 2 英文边界 / 2 现有中文义项，一一对应，无合并。这是最干净的样本：名词「战役」与动词「战斗」分属两条边界，中文侧本来就分对了。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of some action or campaign。
对应英文 raw=1 battle or contend against in or as if in a battle。

senses.note: a hostile meeting of opposing military forces。线索：a / the Battle of + 地名 / battle cry。军事义，与 s2 分界在有无具体战役。
battle or contend against in or as if in a battle。线索：battle against / battle with。也可抽象用（battle with cancer）。
